Whether traveling for leisure or business, guests can enjoy the rooftop infinity pool, sky-high Jacuzzi, and spacious rooms with panoramic city views. The hotel combines modern elegance with authentic Vietnamese charm, ensuring a sophisticated stay in the heart of Hanoi's Old Quarter. Located within walking distance of Hanoi’s top attractions, Hanoi Solis Hotel is perfectly situated for exploring the city. A 2-minute walk takes you to Hoan Kiem Lake and Ngoc Son Temple, while a 5-minute drive reaches the Hanoi Opera House and Thang Long Water Puppet Theatre. Surrounded by Hanoi's best street food, cafés, and vibrant shopping streets, the hotel offers guests a unique cultural experience, blending luxury with local flavor. At Hanoi Solis Hotel, international travelers are welcomed with warmth and care. With nearby restaurants offering diverse cuisine options, from authentic Vietnamese to Indian, Chinese, and Halal dishes, guests can enjoy a truly global dining experience. More than just a stay, the hotel provides a cultural journey where guests are treated as part of the family, ensuring unforgettable memories filled with comfort, charm, and exceptional hospitality.
